exceptions.detail: The full prime-bit table, all display/table constants, the 94727-constant perfect-hash census in answer 33, historical sieve timings, and the reported large prime gap were not regenerated. The printed indexing, recurrences and selected constants were checked.

Exercises 10–19: the printed finite-field, branching-map and translation arguments were reviewed; external Lenstra characterization, Buchi decidability and cited rearrangement/generalization results are accepted as cited. No independent reconstruction of all eight MMIX nim-multiplication constants or external proofs was attempted.

Exercises 49–76: no exhaustive optimum-swap census, full 64-bit replay of the explicit 7-by-9 permutation masks, or independent implementation of every matrix/network example. Printed recursive constructions and routing criteria were reviewed; research problems 61 and 76 remain research exceptions.

The general scattered right-shift routine in answer 83 was reviewed with its gap invariant and a hand case, without a complete implementation test. Alpha-blend maximum/mean errors and probabilities in answer 91 were not regenerated over all 256^3 cases. Historical timing claims were not benchmarked.

Answer 104: the ordinary date-field calculation was reviewed, but unrestricted high-bit validation is not certified. The tested borrow flags are periodic in the packed input modulo 2^24, hence in the year modulo 2^15. Larger encoded years can alias an ordinary valid year. This is retained as an explicit input-domain caveat, not promoted on a disputed implicit date domain.

Broadword logarithm, minterm construction and pattern detection were checked through their printed field/mask arguments, without an exhaustive implementation or independent asymptotic-optimality proof. Exercise 112 remains open research; its printed reductions were read.
